study: spec 032: the carried prior where the ownship's legs outlast the 2-hour window (not a gate)
registered: 2026-11-20, before seeds 367 and 368 exist (generated only in their CI runs)

seeds.tuning: 366 (spent; spec 031's test seed, different engagements under legs-tuning.json)

systems.a: carry2 on 2-hour windows overlapping 30 min: ctl (ctl-d1-q0.01) and ctl-prior (also ctl-carry, ctl-prior-noguard, history-map)
systems.c: jointheld at 7200/1800: ctl on the union of each turn-free 2-hour window and the one before it, read on the window's rows; history-best over the union as the span reference

windows: held = no ownship turn overlaps the 2-hour window; excluded: each chain's first window, windows with no hand-over in (a), windows that ctl, ctl-prior or (c) leaves unanswered; windows where the guard fell back are kept (fall-back is to ctl-carry, not ctl)

estimands.harm: ctl ÷ ctl-prior on one-turn windows (handed on, both answered)
estimands.statistic: geometric mean over windows of per-window median range error; 95% interval from 2,000 bootstrap resamples over engagements (seed 32)

reading: E1 and E2: 'ctl-prior better' if the lower limit is above 1, 'ctl-prior worse' if the upper limit is below 1, else 'not separated, at this size'; harm if the one-turn upper limit is below 1

soundness_on_validation.S1: every engagement present for (a) and (c); at least 95% of (a)'s windows ran
soundness_on_validation.S2: per-engagement geometric mean of ctl ÷ the true-history fit in [0.8, 4]
soundness_on_validation.S3: coverage of the carried 95% region on decided held hand-overs in [0.80, 0.99] (median NEES reported)
soundness_on_validation.on_failure: the study stops before the test
